title: [Bug] Anthropic API Error: Cannot modify thinking blocks in resumed conversations
body:
**Bug Description**
When resuming a conversation and sending a new message. Seeing this error:
API Error: 400 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"messages.7.content.66: `thinking` or `redacted_thinking` blocks in 
    the latest assistant message cannot be modified. These blocks must remain as they were in the original 
    response."},"request_id":"req_011CVu7WQxn7h4mJToammxLt"}

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 2.0.61
